contents.entry: Pointers: parent, siblings, the eight G6 volumes
The five screens and where each is specified
Hosting: the existing Jenkins, ghcr, gitops, Argo path
The owner's requirements and their proofs

pointers.shared: The bearings page the map lives inside
Tier promotion with the screenshot proof

purpose.s: The G6 node volumes already carry the map screens and hosting, so this is a pointer volume (brief C: shared/command-center.xml if no node volume carries the map, else a pointer volume); it exists so an agent asked for "the command center" reads one page and follows one pointer per concern.
The map replaces /board on every tier; nothing exists outside the panel; every panel binds to a store record (N-37 enforces it: an unbound panel fails the build).

screens.s: Map (N-38): DAG nodes as machines with status and heartbeat, queues as belts with depth, seats in flight as inserters (one per live lease row), the HOLD or USERGO lamp; panels at nodes/N-38/spec.xml#panels; frame budget map.frame_budget_ms 16.
Machine (N-39): one node's input, output, attempt, lease with its fencing token, heartbeat age and last records; panels at nodes/N-39/spec.xml#panels.
Stats (N-40): the counters view (state-store.xml#view-counters) as a production statistics panel; panels at nodes/N-40/spec.xml#panels.
Alerts (N-41): every record whose code acts is owner (status-codes.xml#acts), stalls, dead, rejected main, unhealthy, with ack and the escalation bound; panels at nodes/N-41/spec.xml#panels.

Controls (N-42): hold flag, build-mode state, the watcher lamp (the C32 defect fix: a card cannot post unless the tier's watcher is alive), health, and the one-time break glass; panels at nodes/N-42/spec.xml#panels.
Mobile first: iPhone 16 Pro Max, 430 CSS px, safe areas; the Krastorio feel on web and mobile alike; the screenshot seat proves both widths (seat-contract.xml#screenshot-seat).

hosting.s: Jenkinsfile with jenkins-shared-lib, image on ghcr.io/jkkelley, app entry in homelab-gitops, Argo auto-sync, HAProxy ingress, Lightsail front door, name map.gatehouse.click, hello page first (N-35); the stable promotion is a gitops tag bump with Argo sync status readable by the tick.

The tailnet front door for the phone (PR 186, PR 187; N-34) is the current state of the bearings page and carries the live map at /board with the owner key; the map's public front door is Lightsail and serves a static build with no stream, no owner data and no key until a tunnel node exists (ruling in nodes/N-38/spec.xml#mechanism step 2; later item rejected-with-reason.xml#public-map-stream). The browser transport for both is server-sent events (nodes/N-31/spec.xml#transport-choice).

Credentials by placement: the ghcr push token and the gitops deploy key live in Jenkins credentials and the Argo cluster; no seat and no Go service process holds them (seat-contract.xml#credential-by-placement).

art.s: No Wube-derived or BiusArt sprite ever ships; 260 high-confidence Krastor originals (art inventory class 1) may ship with the attribution text of the inventory's section 6; belts, inserters, lamps and pipes have no safe source and are original art (art.gap 300 cuts an originals ticket as data, N-36).
The atlas is built by a pod from the inventory record (N-36 through N-23 suite entry art and N-24); the atlas sha256 is the idempotency key; 422 art.rejected is never retried.

look.s: Every owner-facing view carries the Krastorio 2 and Factorio GUI look, values only (principles.xml#krastorio-look carries the token table as CSS custom properties); the lamp colours of status-codes.xml#lamp map to --k2-green, --k2-accent (amber) and --k2-red.

N-48's look check and N-32's Playwright assertions read the tokens from the page; a tier promotion carries the screenshot at 1440 and 430 as proof (memory screenshot-every-page-change: picture first, read by the owner, flaws named, then the card).

requirements.s: Owner notes 1 to 6 (build-notes.md), each with its proof: 1 the map is the board, proof /board redirects to the map on every tier (N-32 Playwright); 2 one to one Factorio down to the images, proof the look check and the art record with no class 2 to 4 file (N-36, N-48); 3 60 fps pushed state, proof frame.report p95 under map.frame_budget_ms (N-38); 4 every panel bound to a record, proof binding.check passing with zero unbound (N-37); 5 phone first, proof the 430 screenshot on every promotion (N-48); 6 nothing outside the panel, proof the route table of N-32 has no other owner-facing route.

The wireframe (C32 approval; scratchpad/wireframe and build-plan.json with 50 frames over five screens) is the source of the panel list; dev then uat then stable, each tier promoted by N-48 without stopping the watcher. Who gates a page change is decided once in nodes/N-48/spec.xml#owner-confirm: the owner confirms on the uat card a change to the owner-locked page assets (page.html, theme.css) before it merges; every other change, the map bundle included, merges on the machine verdict and reaches stable with an after-the-fact card carrying the screenshot.

many-agents.readers: Eight G6 authors and every screen read this page by anchor; it holds no state and no registry, so there is nothing to collide on.
many-agents.writers: Each screen's panels live in its own volume (principles.xml#one-file-one-in-flight); the registries (bindings.json, machines.json) are generated by N-37 from the screen volumes and index.xml#nodes, never hand-edited; this pointer volume changes only when a screen volume is added or renamed.
many-agents.collision: Two tickets touching one screen volume or tools/map/registry/** are refused at readiness by the file claim (N-14 need declared by N-37).
